about.title: About Me
about.description: State Engineer in Computer Systems and Networks with practical experience in network and systems administration, infrastructure monitoring, security and IT support. Experienced with Cisco, FortiGate, Zabbix, VMware/ESXi, Linux and Windows environments, with additional expertise in operational cybersecurity and threat detection.

jobs.role: Internship - IT Consultant / Assistant Trainer – Systems, Networks & Security
tasks: Deployed and configured Zabbix to monitor machines, servers and network devices across the ACLS infrastructure.
Presented and demonstrated the main Zabbix features to training participants.
Prepared and studied FortiGate and FortiMail environments through administrator guides and lab workbooks.
Assisted with Fortinet client training sessions.
Supported participants in diagnosing and resolving issues encountered during hands-on labs.

jobs.role: Final Year Internship (PFE) – Cybersecurity Engineer (Detection & Automation)
tasks: Designed and deployed a Breach & Attack Simulation (BAS) architecture based on MITRE ATT&CK using OpenAEV and Caldera.
Developed a Python correlation engine to automatically link attack simulations to SIEM alerts.
Deployed Sysmon and Winlogbeat for advanced telemetry and threat detection.
Created custom SOC dashboards in Kibana for real-time detection and prevention KPI visualization.
Secured enterprise backups using Restic and encrypted cloud storage.
Configured Linux environments, automated backups, and ensured data encryption.
Designed and implemented an MPLS network to interconnect multiple sites.
Configured routers and switches, implemented network segmentation via VLANs, and set up dynamic routing.
Configured a Linux-based router with a FreeRADIUS authentication server.
Repaired and installed computer hardware and IT equipment.
Performed software and hardware maintenance, workstation configuration, and network troubleshooting.

items.title: Network Monitoring with Zabbix
items.description: Deployed and configured Zabbix to supervise a multi-component IT infrastructure including servers, workstations and network devices. Set up real-time alerting (email, SMS), SNMP monitoring and custom dashboards for infrastructure visibility.

items.title: Network Monitoring with Nagios
items.description: Implemented an open-source monitoring solution on Linux for managing complex IT environments. Configured real-time alerting (SMS, Email) to ensure service continuity, reduce downtime and optimize network maintenance.

items.title: Wazuh + Elasticsearch – Intrusion Detection
items.description: Designed a centralized SIEM system using Wazuh for intrusion detection and the ELK Stack for event correlation. Integrated Suricata and VirusTotal to enrich telemetry and automate malware detection.

items.title: Zero Trust Architecture for 5G Standalone
items.description: Designed a multi-layer security architecture based on Zero Trust principles to protect the critical components of a 5G Standalone core network, addressing the expanded attack surface introduced by 5G evolution.

items.title: Web Vulnerability Assessment with Nessus
items.description: In-depth vulnerability analysis of a web server using Nessus. Identified potential security flaws, assessed associated risks and produced technical recommendations to strengthen infrastructure resilience.
